### Blessing of Not Seeing
Author: Megan Hill
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/blessing-not-seeing/
Passage: John 20:29
Points:
- Believers often wish they could have physically seen, heard, and touched Jesus during His earthly life.
- Jesus declared a unique blessing over later generations who believe in Him without physical sight.
- True spiritual faith comes through the Holy Spirit rather than through chasing visible signs or miracles.
- We encounter the risen Christ today through prayer, the Scriptures, the sacraments, and the gathered church.
- Christians walk by faith now while awaiting the day when Christ returns and every eye sees Him.

### The Day a Doubter Believed
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/the-day-a-doubter-believed-greg-laurie-devotion-march-31-2021.html
Passage: John 20:29
Points:
- Struggling with honest doubt does not mean a person cannot come to Jesus.
- Thomas wanted to know the truth for himself rather than relying on the reports of others.
- Jesus met Thomas where he was, addressing his skepticism and calling him to faith.
- No one can live on secondhand faith; each individual must bring their questions directly to the Lord.
- Rather than waiting to see before believing, faith begins by trusting God's word.
